Japanese.goal: 新入生向けの卒業生メンター制度があるか確認する
Japanese.hint: 新入生に卒業生のメンターがつくか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Review completed application checklist with the admissions counselor
tasks.hint: Go over checklist items with counselor before leaving.
tasks.done_when: Learner reviewed completed application checklist with admissions counselor.
tasks.scene_hint: Soundproof consultation rooms allow confidential financial discussions.

Japanese.goal: 記入済みの出願チェックリストを入試カウンセラーと一緒に確認する
Japanese.hint: 帰る前に、チェックリストの項目をカウンセラーと確認しましょう。

tasks.goal: Request a printed receipt confirming payment of the application deposit
tasks.hint: Ask for paper proof of tuition deposit payment.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested printed receipt confirming application deposit payment.

Japanese.goal: 出願の預け金の支払いを証明する印刷した領収書をお願いする
Japanese.hint: 授業料の預け金を払った証明を紙でもらいましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask counselor for direct email address for follow-up documentation questions
tasks.hint: Inquire how to email counselor directly later.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked counselor for direct email address for follow-up questions.

Japanese.goal: 追加書類について問い合わせるため、カウンセラーの直通メールアドレスを尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 後でカウンセラーに直接メールする方法を聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire about official notification dates for early decision acceptance
tasks.hint: Ask when early decision results are posted.
tasks.done_when: Learner inquired about notification dates for early decision acceptance.

Japanese.goal: 早期出願（専願）の合否が正式に発表される日について尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 早期出願の結果がいつ発表されるか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Confirm that all submitted recommendation letters have been received
tasks.hint: Verify that reference letters are logged in portal.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed all recommendation letters have been received.

Japanese.goal: 提出したすべての推薦状が届いているか確認する
Japanese.hint: 推薦状が出願サイトに登録されているか確認しましょう。

tasks.goal: Thank the admissions officer for guidance on the application process
tasks.hint: Express gratitude to counselor before departing.
tasks.done_when: Learner thanked admissions officer for guidance on application process.
tasks.scene_hint: Official university stamps and seal embosser rest on the main counter desk.

Japanese.goal: 出願の手続きについて案内してくれた入試担当者にお礼を言う
Japanese.hint: 帰る前にカウンセラーに感謝の気持ちを伝えましょう。
